cues.headline: End to end now!
cues.body: Nobody can keep the ball: it's changing hands 5.8 times a minute. Anything can happen.

cues.headline: Rapid!
cues.body: Ander Sallow just flew past at 27 km/h, the fastest of the match.

cues.headline: Nobody's in charge now
cues.body: The game has settled. Ball over the last 5 minutes: Ashvale Town 42%, Ravenmoor United 58%. Neither team on top.

cues.headline: Ravenmoor United have taken over
cues.body: The game is going Ravenmoor United's way: winning the ball back in the opposition half 3 times and winning 80% of the midfield duels in the last 5 minutes.

cues.headline: GOAL! Teo Rossiter!
cues.body: Ravenmoor United score! It's Ashvale Town 0–1 Ravenmoor United. Ravenmoor United won it straight back and the move took 7 seconds.

cues.headline: Bram Holm scores!
cues.body: Get in! Ashvale Town 1–1 Ravenmoor United. It had been coming: Ashvale Town were in control.

cues.headline: So close!
cues.body: Ander Sallow should have scored: chances like that go in 42% of the time.

cues.headline: It's all gone wild
cues.body: The ball is changing hands 7.0 times a minute. Neither side can calm it down.

cues.headline: It's in! Emil Morrow!
cues.body: Emil Morrow finds the net for Ashvale Town: Ashvale Town 2–1 Ravenmoor United. It had been coming: Ashvale Town were in control. A long ball over the press set it up.

recap.headline: Full time: Ashvale Town 2–1 Ravenmoor United
recap.summary: A deserved win for Ashvale Town.
